ending.title: A home worth keeping
ending.text: There is grain for the next sowing, a roof against the rain, and room to think beyond tomorrow. The year asked much of you. You have given this home another spring.

decisions.title: Work with what we have
decisions.detail: You chose to plant without the ox, keeping your money and independence.

decisions.title: Promise him a fair share
decisions.detail: You set aside money for Petru’s own needs and recognised his place in household decisions. He will add provisions at harvest.

decisions.title: Leave it until spring
decisions.detail: You kept your money. The inheritance disagreement will still need an answer next spring.
